_comment: Copy to <tenantId>/<version>.json, fill in real cases, delete every _comment. Validate with scripts/validate_gold_set.py --check-corpus before gating. This file is a skeleton, not a valid gold set (it has no cases); it is excluded from CI by living at the gold_sets/ root, not under a <tenantId>/ dir.
corpusVersionAtCuration: the corpusVersion the chunk ids were curated against

cases._comment: Duplicate this block per case. id is RE-NNN, unique, never reused.
cases.query: The user-form question, exactly as the chatbot would receive it.
cases.notes: Curator rationale for inclusion; admin-readable only.
